policy: Matrix cells require source-supported row mechanism plus both control/dependence and performance axes; coverage is not a quota.

changes.title: Does Europe Really Have a Plan for Tech Sovereignty? Tech Policy Press (AI hype and European policymaking series)

previous.matrix_evidence_basis: The source’s core critique is that Europe is pursuing sovereignty through a technology agenda and infrastructure still shaped by external actors.

changes.reason: External influence/dependence is described, but the stored source evidence does not establish a performance benefit delivered by compliance with a foreign rule, licence, standard or platform regime. R-C therefore is not supported.

changes.title: Science Knows No Borders: ALLEA condemns proposed restrictions on international research collaboration

previous.matrix_evidence_basis: The source advocates open international science (claimed A) while arguing that a more autonomous/restrictive funding regime imposes material scientific and institutional costs (implied B).

changes.reason: The source concerns proposed US grant restrictions harming international science. It is not evidence of a European self-imposed safeguard that buys more control at a collaboration cost, so K-B is not supported.

changes.title: Europe’s venture capital gap and the financing of high-growth firms

previous.matrix_evidence_basis: The source explicitly links foreign late-stage financing dependence to loss of European value capture.

changes.reason: The source explicitly links Europe’s late-stage financing gap to a risk that high-growth firms move headquarters, talent, IP or listings abroad. That is a conversion loss/exit mechanism (C-D), not productive external dependence (C-C).

changes.title: European Tech Sovereignty

previous.matrix_evidence_basis: The source explicitly advocates protected European capability and preference measures; it is classified as an advocacy claim, not empirical proof of their effects.

changes.reason: The source advocates preference/protection measures, but the stored evidence does not demonstrate the cost, delay, fragmentation or performance penalty required for a B-cell trade-off.

changes.title: Europe Tackles Tech Sovereignty
changes.source: German Marshall Fund of the United States (GMF)

previous.matrix_evidence_basis: The reviewed argument explicitly favours managed external technological relationships and diversification rather than full separation, fitting productive dependence.

changes.reason: Managed external relationships and diversification are discussed, but the stored evidence does not show an external input actually enabling European performance while dependence remains. I-C therefore is not supported.

changes.title: Exploring the investor landscape for venture capital

previous.matrix_evidence_basis: The diagnosis is dependence on insufficient European capital, while the advocated remedy is stronger home financing; implied current outcome is productive dependence/foreign financing.

changes.reason: The record infers foreign productive dependence from a shortage of European institutional capital; the stored evidence does not directly show foreign capital enabling scale. C-C therefore is not supported.

changes.title: AI researcher with a prior European Space Agency placement arrested at NATO’s SHAPE on suspicion of espionage
changes.source: Follow the Money / Belgian Federal Prosecutor

previous.matrix_evidence_basis: The event is evidence of the security pressure behind restrictions and screening around European research/talent access, matching the Knowledge-row closed-lab mechanism (K-B).

changes.reason: The incident shows a security concern, not an implemented European safeguard plus a demonstrated collaboration/mobility cost. K-B therefore is not supported.
